    49	    def validate_assignments(self, assignments: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[str]:

    51	        Validate all hard constraints.
    52	
    53	        Returns list of validation errors (empty if valid).
    54	        """
    55	        errors = []
    56	
    57	        # Build lookup structures
    58	        assignment_map = {a["shipment_id"]: a for a in assignments}
